# Contributing

[Русская версия](CONTRIBUTING_ru.md)

Use Node.js 22 and npm ci. Run npm run lint and npm run build. Review code examples against the documented library version; preserve API terminology and existing attribution. Library documentation should use English with a Russian duplicate. Existing Russian pages require a separate, reviewed translation. Use Conventional Commits, English code comments, and no committed credentials or build output. Maintainer: Ivan Zorin, <creator@localzet.com>.
